description: Install the plugins behind missing REQUIRED external deps during compose setup/init/update instead of printing a hint and running degraded. A clean install reported '6 of 12 deps missing (4 required)' and warned the lifecycle would run degraded, so reaching a working state depended on the user reading the report. Manifest entries gain a structured `plugin` spec and `marketplace_source`; the human `install` string is never executed (several entries are prose, and shelling manifest text is an injection surface). Required only, deduped by plugin, marketplace registered and install retried once on a pristine machine, post-install rescan reported. Opt out via --no-install-deps / COMPOSE_NO_PLUGIN_INSTALL=1; doctor stays read-only. Also fixes a scanner bug found while building it: the plugin cache outlives `claude plugin uninstall`, so an uninstalled plugin read as present and auto-install would never have fired.
